name: Subsea separation and water reinjection
principle: A seabed separator splits water and sand from the flow; the water is reinjected, so the host handles only oil and gas. Equinor's Tordis system, planned when water reached 70 to 80% and sand 500 kg/day, was expected to raise recovery from 49% to 55% (about 35 million barrels).

process_steps.name: Boost oil to host and water to injection

source.note: Offshore magazine, Tordis becomes world's first subsea processing installation

advantages: Frees up topside water handling capacity
limitations: The article gives no throughput, start date or cost
